name: ForgeUI Component

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 ForgeUI 提供可复制粘贴的 shadcn/ui 风格 React + Tailwind 组件与页面区块，首页可进入 Components、Blocks、Illustrations、Templates 等入口；区块页按 Header、Hero、Pricing、FAQ 等分类浏览，并提供 header01、header02 等预览链接。Pro 版宣称含 250+ UI 区块、10 个 Next.js + Tailwind 模板及 Framer Motion/GSAP 动画。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by ForgeUI (https://forgeui.in/).
Technology stack: react, tailwind, gsap, motion.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
